QF.id: IV Clearing Settlement and Risk Management_27

question.text: How is the Final Settlement Price determined for MIBOR futures?

answer.text: Average of daily overnight MIBOR rates during the contract month
MIBOR rate on the last trading day
Weighted average of MIBOR rates with higher weight to recent days
RBI repo rate on the settlement date

explanation.text: The Logic: Per pages 115 and 240 of the NISM Series IV workbook, the Overnight MIBOR Futures final settlement price is the simple average of the daily FBIL overnight MIBOR or Overnight Call Rate applicable for the contract month. The Trap: It is not the last day's rate; it is the simple average over the contract month. There is no weighting that gives recent days higher weight. The RBI repo rate is a different reference and is not the FSP for MIBOR futures. Note: Source-backed final-settlement rule from pages 115 and 240 of Series IV: simple average of daily FBIL overnight MIBOR or Overnight Call Rate applicable for the contract month.
